# Architecture Recommendation

Based on the stated constraints, I recommend a **modular, component-based architecture** (such as a well-structured MVC or modern component framework like React/Vue) with **accessibility built into the design system from the start**. This approach satisfies WCAG 2.1 AA compliance through reusable, tested accessible components while maximizing maintainability and minimizing long-term costs through reduced duplication and easier updates. Avoid simply copying the competitor's approach—instead, focus on your specific stakeholder priorities of maintainability and cost-efficiency, which this pattern directly supports.
